_notes: Canonical MCP server config for au-gov-data. Edit only this file. Run scripts/render-mcp.py to regenerate .mcp.json / .gemini/settings.json / .codex/config.toml / .vscode/mcp.json.
_connection_model: Every server reaches every host the package targets. No-auth HTTP MCPs and stdio servers need no sign-in. An authenticated HTTP MCP (catalog auth: oauth, e.g. stromy-format, asset-broker, toolkit, stromy-workflows) is a standard MCP OAuth 2.1 server (RFC 9728 resource metadata, dynamic client registration and client ID metadata documents, PKCE S256). It is declared once with `_connector: true`, its catalog hosted_url and no headers, and each host signs the user in through its own redirect: Claude on the plugin's Connectors tab, local CLIs and IDEs through a browser callback, ChatGPT through its connector sign-in. See infra-docs/ai/mcp-connection-model.md (enforced by validate-plugin-completeness.py Invariant #13).
